The analysis is clear. The test image shows:
- **Green stems remaining alive** while pods are fully matured and dried/brown
- No leaf lesions, no mold, no stem rot - just the distinctive green stem / mature pod contrast

This is the hallmark of **Green Stem Disorder** - where stems fail to senesce normally while pods ripen. The reference collage for Green_stem_disorder shows identical scenes (green stems with brown dry pods, dark soil background, same late-season field context). All other candidates (Anthracnose, White Mold, Bean Pod Mottle, Frogeye, etc.) show distinct leaf or pod lesion patterns not present here.
